evidence: Carries the P2P label and substantially modifies src/net_processing.cpp, src/blockencodings.cpp, and src/net.cpp to optimize BIP152 compact block relay.
rationale: Predictive prefilling addresses the roughly 43% of block reconstructions that currently require an extra high-latency GETBLOCKTXN round-trip to fetch missing transactions. Reducing round-trips meaningfully accelerates block propagation across the network and lowers stale block risk without unbounded TCP buffer bloat.
